news.title: Bitcoin steady above $78,000, HYPE leads as majors slip on hawkish Fed bets
news.summary: Ether, solana, tron and dogecoin all shed ground over 24 hours while HYPE added about 4%, leaving bitcoin flat on the week after August's 24% run.

news.summary: Bitcoin ETFs took in $217 million on Monday, one session after an outflow ended their nine-day run. Ether ETFs have not had net outflows since mid-August.
